policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Urine Culture Testing for Bacteria

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Urine culture testing (CPT code 87076, CPT code 87077, CPT code 87140, CPT code 87147, CPT code 87149*, CPT code 87181, CPT code 87186) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a primary diagnosis representing a general encounter without abnormal findings or similar examination.
